column2: Rule in plain words
Free floor: every pathway has free tools that work in every light and setting; the primary action is always something the user can open on their plan.
Safety and access are never paid: check-in, engine, card, Help/SOS, safety override, support plan, communication cards, accessibility, consent, export and delete.
No upselling under strain: no Prime/Premium tiles, prompts or paywalls in Amber or Red, at High+ difficult feelings, after a safety event or during a session.
Faith practice is never paid: the user's own prayers, rituals, schedules and reminders are free; only FigCit-produced guided content is Prime or Premium.
Same safety rules in every plan; paying never unlocks a blocked pathway.
Lapse keeps data: content stays readable and exportable; paid tools lock; nothing is deleted.
Organisation seats unlock Premium for covered users automatically; organisations get no extra access to individual data.

Honest pricing: prices are shown before VAT and VAT is added at checkout, with the total shown before payment; cancel in two taps; no countdowns or guilt copy; adults only; 16–17s only through an organisation seat.
Tier changes are configuration with Product Owner approval (and clinical review for Regulate, Connect and communication cards).

Prices are configuration and must match the business plan: Prime £7 a month or £70 a year; Premium £13 a month or £130 a year; organisation seat (Premium) £10 a month or £100 a year — all before VAT. Annual = 12 months for the price of 10.
On the card, a free user may see at most ONE labelled Prime or Premium alternative, and only in Green, Yellow (Mild/Moderate) or Blue.
